environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to port 8080. The ADMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set via ECS task definition environment variable with value '0123456789abcdef' (default). No network restrictions on who can reach the ALB. Security groups allow 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. The service token validation only checks for presence (non-empty), not validity.
